Next.js 16 App Router club management system for TJ Sokol Svinov (Czech handball club); TypeScript strict, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth), TanStack Query v5, HeroUI v2, Tailwind CSS v4, Vitest. UI language is **Czech** — all user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Use `.claude/skills/` proactively when applicable:
`/new-entity` for new database table, data model, or CRUD feature. Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill.
`/db-sync` after any DB migration is applied or when TypeScript types are out of sync with the database schema.
`/new-migration` whenever a new table, column, function, view, or RLS policy needs to be created in the database.
`/generate-barrels` after adding, renaming, or removing any hook, component, type, or enum file. Run before committing.
`/review-pr` for code review, PR review, or "check my changes".
Follow these patterns strictly. Do not deviate without explicit user instruction.

Entity layout:
`src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` (AUTO-GENERATED, do not edit manually); `data/{camelCase}.ts` (domain types extending schema).
`src/queries/{pluralCamel}/`: `constants.ts` (DB_TABLE + ENTITY), `queries.ts` (read), `mutations.ts` (write), `index.ts` (barrel).
`src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts` (createDataFetchHook factory); `state/use{Entity}.ts` (createCRUDHook factory).
`src/lib/translations/{pluralCamel}.ts` (Czech strings).

Client component/browser: `supabaseBrowserClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/client`; server component: `supabaseServerClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/server`. API routes: `withAuth(handler)`, `withAdminAuth(handler)`, `withPublicAccess(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers` (authenticated, admin-only, public respectively). Coach role checks: `hasCoachRole()` / `isAdmin()` / `checkCoachCardAccess()` from `@/utils/supabase/coachAuth` — these are **auth helpers, not clients**.
Never import a server client in a client component or vice versa.
Prefer `apiHelpers` wrappers over calling `supabaseServerClient()` directly in API routes — they handle auth, 401/403, and error responses consistently.
All query/mutation functions in `src/queries/` receive `ctx: QueryContext` as first argument and use `ctx.supabase`. Never call the Supabase client directly inside query files.

These files are **auto-generated** — never edit manually, always regenerate: `src/hooks/index.ts`, `src/types/index.ts`, `src/components/index.ts`.
These files are **manual** — always update by hand: `src/lib/api-routes.ts`, `src/lib/translations/index.ts`.
`scripts/generate-component-exports.mjs` opt-outs: file-level add `// <REDACTED_USER>` on any of first 5 lines of `.ts`/`.tsx`; folder-level add empty `.barrel-ignore` (e.g. `SomeComponent/utils/.barrel-ignore`). Use for non-public utility/helper files inside component folders; generator logs `⏭️  Skipping ...`.

Use layout components instead of raw Tailwind flex/grid classes for consistent spacing and responsive breakpoints. **Important:** Tailwind CSS does not support dynamic class construction (e.g. `` `flex-${direction}` ``). All layout components use static lookup maps to generate classes. Follow this pattern when creating new layout components.
Import from `@/components`: `<Grid columns={3} gap="md">` / `<GridItem span={2}>`; columns 1-6 (default 3), gap sm/md/lg/xl (default md), span 1-6 (default 1). Files: `src/components/ui/Grid/Grid.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Grid/components/GridItem.tsx`.
